newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GAS COMPANY POSTS 15.98 MLN LITAS LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: GAS COMPANY POSTS 15.98 MLN LITAS LOSSES.

text.p: Lithuanian Gas said on Tuesday that its audited results for 1996 showed a loss of 15.98 million litas.

The huge state-run gas company did not provide any comparative figures for 1995 because it said that the results from the two years could not be compared as different accounting standards were applied in both cases.

"The losses of the company were 15.98 million litas, but the auditor said it was unusre how to interpret the sum of 79.6 million litas in late payments to Russia's Lentrasgaz," the firm's general director, Kestutis Shumacheris, told Reuters.
Shumacheris said that the finance ministry had ruled that the debt, which dates back to 1992 and 1993, belonged to the state but the issue had not be fully resolved yet.
The company has plans for a 66 million litas share issue but the government still has to decide on the final price of the shares.
News of the loss hit the company's share price on the bourse today, pushing it down to 1.82 litas from 2.00 litas.
But dealers said they were confident that its price would quickly rebound as it looked like a real bargain at the moment.
